messages:
sasha: heads-up: observed a ~12% tail-latency spike on the INT8 KV path in v0.9.3 when cache size > ~60k entries
eli: saw bump in the dashboards earlier, nice catch. which model and workload?
sasha: repro on small internal gpt2-7b-like profile, seq=1024, batch=1, heavy prefix reuse. KV stored as INT8. interestingly decode sometimes switches to an FP8 fallback kernel and latency jumps.
maya: can you paste perf counters / a few lines from pprof? also saw more GPU memcpy in related run.
sasha: snippets from the host logs:
```
[2024-04-25T10:17:12Z] route=kv_lookup latency_ms=3.2 cache_size=67000 quant_mode=INT8 decode_kernel=fp8_fallback
[2024-04-25T10:17:12Z] kv_cache_saturation=1 kv_page_walks=3120 kernel_switches=47
[2024-04-25T10:17:12Z] decode_latency_ms=98 tail_p99=422
```
eli: kv_page_walks high -> page-table thrash / allocator churn. are we evicting large pages when cache grows?
jorge: fwiw the dynamic-quant path has a short hysteresis window (100ms) for kernel switching. with bursty request patterns that causes oscillation between int8 and fp8 kernels.
maya: perf-ci-bot run attached: run 214 shows +8.7% p99 on decode for this branch :thinking: (link: http://ci/perf/214)
perf-ci-bot: perf results for run 214: baseline_p99=92ms current_p99=100ms regression=8.7%
sasha: repro script for local testing:
```
./tools/repro_kv_burst --model gpt2-7b --seq 1024 --cache 70000 --quant int8 --batch-pattern burst
```
eli: initial hypothesis: when cache_size crosses threshold we map pages with different alignment/strides and our INT8 kernel suffers non-coalesced loads, GPU memcpys spike, and our runtime flips to an FP8 fallback to preserve decode correctness -> double penalty.
tori: quick mitigation idea: increase kernel-switch hysteresis to 250ms and bias toward INT8 kernel when cache_size > 60k. we can experiment with a config flag.
sasha: trying config flip in staging now.
deploy-bot: deploy started: configs/kv/quant_hysteresis -> 250ms (staging) by sasha
sasha: staging perf after flip: p99 down from 100ms -> 94ms, kernel_switches dropped from ~47/min -> ~4/min :thumbsup:
maya: good signal. but we should also capture new telemetry: kernel_switch_count per minute, kv_page_walks, avg_page_size, and quant_fallback_count.
jorge: long-term fixes: 1) improve allocator for INT8 KV pages to reduce pagewalks 2) add cache-aware kernel selection that considers cache_size and recent switch history 3) investigate a lightweight INT8-friendly memcpy kernel for odd strides.
eli: action plan:
- Canaries: roll hysteresis change to 5% canary tomorrow, watch p99 and kernel_switch_rate.
- Alerts: add an alert for kernel_switch_rate > 20/min and kv_page_walks spike > 1k/min.
- Tests: add a new perf CI scenario (kv_burst_large_cache) that runs 30m soak.
- Ticket: PROJ-3427 created with repro + logs + suggested mitigations.
sasha: added repro + perf pprof link to PROJ-3427. assigned to eng-runtime.
tori: pinging @eli to own canary and #oncall for rollback criteria.
eli: i'll own the canary rollout and monitor for 6h. if p99 regresses by >3% or error rate jumps, we roll back.
sasha: thanks all — summary: root cause looks like kernel-selection oscillation + allocator-induced pagewalks when KV quantized pages are large. short-term config tweak helps, followups for allocator + smarter selector needed. :rocket:
